# TabBarItem

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:tabs` · Kerf UI · component · Navigation

Roving-tabindex-ready tabs with typed compact, segmented, icon-only, drop-target, pinned, and name-overflow presentations.

## When to use

Render a controlled application tab with compact or icon-only presentation, a visible drop target, optional full-name display, and an optional pinned leading position.

- Render one controlled application tab inside TabBar.

**Not when:**

- Do not render alone or use for a compact settings choice.

**Alternatives:**

- [SegmentedControl](./segmented-control.md) (nearest)

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/tab-bar-item` — exports `TabBarItem`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/tab-bar-item` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/tab-bar-item.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/tab-bar-item`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuitab-bar-item) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- selected
- closable
- draggable
- leading
- trailing
- custom close icon
- root metadata
- compact size
- segmented presentation
- icon-only accessible presentation
- label maximum width and ellipsis or visible name overflow
- drop-target highlight
- pinned leading position within a scrolling tablist
- attention name color

## Composition

- Parents: only inside [TabBar](./tab-bar.md).
- Contexts: `tabpanel-navigation`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md).

Zones (a zone is bound to JSX only through its listed prop; never assume the zone id is a prop):

- `leading-decoration` — JSX prop `leading`; accepts `dormant-decoration`; 0–1.
- `trailing-decoration` — JSX prop `trailing`; accepts `dormant-decoration`; 0–1.
- `close-icon` — JSX prop `closeIcon`; accepts `dormant-decoration`; 0–1.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** tab identity; selection; drop-target state; close policy; content; application data attribute values; outer placement.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: navigation). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Compose in a tablist and pair with an application-owned tabpanel.
- Keep closeIcon decorative and free of interactive descendants; the owning close button supplies its accessible name and interaction.
- Use rootAttributes only for application data-\* metadata; component-owned identity, state, action, and role semantics are protected at runtime.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-tab-bar-item`, `kui-tab-bar-item__close`, `kui-tab-bar-item__close-icon`, `kui-tab-bar-item__name`, `kui-tab-bar-item__select`, `kui-tab-bar-item__trailing`.

Never put `kui-tab-bar-item`, `kui-tab-bar-item__close`, `kui-tab-bar-item__close-icon`, `kui-tab-bar-item__name`, `kui-tab-bar-item__select`, `kui-tab-bar-item__trailing` on an element you write; render `TabBarItem` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-tab-bar-item-attention-color`, `--kui-tab-bar-item-color`, `--kui-tab-bar-item-drop-indicator`, `--kui-tab-bar-item-drop-target-background`, `--kui-tab-bar-item-drop-target-color`, `--kui-tab-bar-item-drop-target-ring`, `--kui-tab-bar-item-hover-background`, `--kui-tab-bar-item-pinned-background`, `--kui-tab-bar-item-pinned-hover-background`, `--kui-tab-bar-item-selected-background`, `--kui-tab-bar-item-selected-border`, `--kui-tab-bar-item-selected-color`, `--kui-color-brand-border-normal`, `--kui-color-brand-on-quiet`, `--kui-color-neutral-border-normal`, `--kui-color-neutral-on-quiet`, `--kui-color-surface`, `--kui-color-text`, `--kui-focus-ring`, `--kui-font-xs`, `--kui-radius-pill`, `--kui-shadow-s`, `--kui-space-2xs`, `--kui-space-xs`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
